summary: OpenAI published a data report (Signals) describing how ChatGPT usage has grown in depth, breadth, and geographic/demographic diversity since 2023.

mechanisms.reason: The document reports sustained growth in messages sent per user and cumulative active users across regions, indicating rising aggregate inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: Six months after signing up, users sent 50% more messages per day than they did when they signed up. They also doubled the number of distinct tasks they’ve tried on ChatGPT.
